title: Just Juice Mint Range XXX Mint Saltfill Shortfill 40ml E-Liquid
description: Just Juice XXX Mint Saltfill delivers an ultra-strong Mint profile with an icy finish. Triple-layered mint notes combine for a strikingly cool vape, perfect for those who prefer a sharper, more powerful mint flavour. Each bottle contains 40ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml shortfill format, leaving space for up to two nic shots. With a 60PG/40VG ratio, this Saltfill is tailored to pod kits and starter devices, producing vivid flavour with a tactile throat hit. Double-concentrated flavouring ensures XXX Mint stays bold and consistent throughout the day. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
